ValidationRule.description: Prevents changing Domain ID when an attempt is made on an existing record. AE role and PCM profile are excepted. https://app.asana.com/0/253313814113822/1201002208961079/f
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(domain_id__c), IF( (ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Admin') || $Profile.Name == 'System Administrator' || $Profile.Name == 'Integration User'), false, IF((ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Account Executive') || ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Partner Channel Lead') || ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Partner Channel Manager') || ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'External Sales Rep')) && PRIORVALUE(domain_id__c) == null , false, IF( $User.Alias = 'amerr' && PRIORVALUE(domain_id__c) == null, false, IF(($Profile.Name == 'Sales Ops' && RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PartnerAccount'), false, true)))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Domain ID can't be changed on this Account.
